title_menu:
Use case: ui-mockup. PRIMARY REQUEST: Redesign the existing title screen as a bold, energetic main menu with exactly two interactive options: "Start Game" and "About". This is an original game UI illustration preview for Oh No My Hair!, not implementation. Match the approved warm rounded cartoon reference: wobbly dark-purple #2b2140 bold outlines, cream and lavender salon, wood counters, coral barber chairs, playful simplified forms, modest soft cartoon shading. No photorealism or 3D. EXACT protagonist identity: two mouthless stick figures, cream round heads, two dark-purple eyes, single-line purple torso and limbs, solid ball hands and feet, NO fingers, clothing, nose, mouth. P1 vivid pink #ff5fa2 large hooked curved twin-tails and central swept fringe; P2 vivid blue #3a8fd6 big forward pointed spiky hair mass. Same proportions as reference, large hair and heads short line bodies. Do not redesign hair as springs/horns/helmets. Text is allowed in these review mockups because actual game UI will be rendered in code. Full-bleed 16:9 landscape, target 1280x720 or 2560x1440. Exactly one finished screen per image, no multi-panel presentation, no device frame, watermark or brand logos. Keep major UI safely inset at least 6%.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 existing title EDIT TARGET, preserve its distinctive hand-lettered logo letterforms; Image 2 approved hero/style reference; Image 3 supplied commercial game cover ONLY a loose reference for energetic diagonal composition, near/far scale and vivid foreground hierarchy. Do not reproduce that cover, characters, fonts, scenes or layout, do not add existing IP.
COMPOSITION: Break the old symmetrical straight-standing composition. Logo occupies upper LEFT 50% in TWO LINES with exact text "Oh No" / "My Hair!" keeping the old connected bouncy rounded brush-letter silhouette and flourishes, but make it markedly bigger and more legible. Recolor ALL letter faces to luminous warm golden yellow #ffd34e, cream glints and burnt golden lower accents #d58a28, thick dark-purple outline plus a cream external keyline, subtle dark-purple offset shadow. NO pink, mint or teal letters. No extra decorative caption.
Below logo on left a generous clear vertical menu: large golden cream pill with purple outline, small purple triangular selection pointer and exact text "Start Game"; smaller cream pill below exact text "About". Bold friendly rounded purple lettering, high legibility; each button about 285x65 at 1280 scale, separated 18px. No "Press any key" anywhere.
RIGHT 55%: huge dynamic full-body duo springing diagonally upward together, P1 at right upper side with arcing pink twin-tails, P2 slightly lower left with forward blue hair, their inner ball hands clasped, outer arms extended, tiny energetic curved motion streaks. Show every hair tip and both feet safely within frame. Cream faces have optimistic oval or crescent eyes but NO mouths. They are the centerpiece, don't occlude menu or title. Their single-line bodies must remain visible, NOT conventional filled human torsos. Hair separation clear. Let hair forms and body poses convey action, no added gadgets.
BACKGROUND: wide cartoon salon in gently exaggerated perspective, tilted mirror frames and curved counter lines create converging diagonal flow toward duo, large low-detail pastel shape clusters. A barber chair and hairdryer as low contrast scenery, maybe a couple floating pink/blue clippings near duo only. Cream wall and warm lavender floor. Keep behind menu quiet and uncluttered. Small barber pole can be background not title font fill. No robot or human barber. This screen should feel like a real inviting indie co-op main menu, not a static character lineup or a movie poster. No credits footer necessary; About content belongs to its separate modal when clicked.
salon_map:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE redesigned level-map screen for original 2D co-op game Oh No My Hair!, landscape 16:9 1280x720 or 2560x1440. This is a finished REVIEW PREVIEW with readable UI text, not a diagram, not a contact sheet.

INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the REJECTED earlier map, use it ONLY to understand four-level concept and exact hero identities. DISCARD its isometric room rendering, interior objects and ornate UI. Image 2 approved title screen is for identity, dark purple linework and warm golden yellow UI family only. Make this new map much flatter, calmer, handmade and sparser.

NEW DIRECTION: a charming flat hand-drawn board-game route on a warm cream sheet-like background. Full screen uniform cream #fff2d9 with TWO very pale lavender flat organic patches behind the route, extremely restrained. NO isometric perspective, architecture, walls, rooms, furniture, bottles, trees, landscape, realistic depth, glossy shading, gradients, bloom or texture noise. A huge amount of deliberate negative space. A consistent slightly wobbly dark purple #2b2140 ink line, flat color fills. Warm golden #ffd34e denotes current stage.

LAYOUT, coordinates at 1280x720: small friendly handwritten header "SALON MAP" at (90,65), no giant boxed header, no tagline. Small cream purple-outlined "Back" button top right safely inset. Main map occupies x150-1110 y200-520. There are EXACTLY FOUR destination discs connected by ONE broad smooth gently winding lavender path, like a simplified board game. No branching and no other discs, no stepping-stone clutter. Place destinations: 1 at (250,450), 2 at (520,300), 3 at (800,430), 4 at (1040,250). The road passes smoothly through them in numerical order; some short sparse center dashes, not dozens of dots. All road art behind labels and characters.

FOCUS: stage 1 is visibly biggest, gold disc with simple thick purple outline and a thin cream border, approx 160px wide. EXACTLY TWO hero friends stand side by side ON this single shared first disc, full-body, about 125px tall each including hair, very clear silhouettes. P1 on left cream round head, two vertical dark-purple eyes, vivid pink hooked twin-tails with swept fringe; P2 right cream round head, two eyes, vivid blue swept-forward spiky hair. Both have SHORT SINGLE-LINE dark-purple body and limbs and round solid ball hands and feet, no mouth, nose, clothing or fingers. Their inner hands touch. Same identities as reference, simplified modest flat fills not gloss. Put a tiny "1" at front of pad not behind bodies. A small gold plaque directly BELOW first pad reads exactly "Fresh Cut". Ensure plaque not overlapping footer.
Stage 2 and 3: smaller muted lavender discs about 80px wide with clearly readable numerals "2" and "3", each ONE small closed lock attached. One cream label directly below each reads exactly "Return to Sender" and "Wash & Blow-Dry" respectively, dark purple hand-lettering at readable scale. No associated big props or icons.
Stage 4: a simple small dark-lavender CLOSED DOOR pictogram on a muted disc. One large cream "?" ON the door, ONE small closed lock. Below only "???" as the label. NO robot, no scissors arms, no eye, no silhouette of an enemy, no boss name, absolutely no spoilers.

SCENERY: at most TWO tiny very pale lavender outline doodles far from labels, a closed pair of scissors at upper left empty field and a simple comb at far bottom-right empty field. These are faint edge accents, not subjects. Do not fill empty space with extra objects, sparkles, clippings, icons, banners or repeated curls.

BOTTOM UI: one shallow simple cream footer plate with purple outline, x80-1200 y590-670. Left exact text "Fresh Cut" and small "Stage 1 / 4". Right one gold rounded button "Play", flat fill. No bevels, shadows or shine. All labels and icons readable. Strong hierarchy: two friends on gold stage first, four-node route second, minimal UI third. NO "The Barber", no "Press any key", extra heroes, duplicate destinations, room cutaways, toy dollhouse aesthetic, ornate plaques or visual clutter. Preserve selected-title identity but not its shiny rendering. Output one simple appealing indie-game map screen.
generation: Built-in image generation; final map replaces isometric draft. References use packaged filenames; no external IP image included.
